answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax: a non-refundable fee burned on registration, like a crushed opal — the payment itself is the signal. At the jetty, an agent pays 50 POA and the fee is destroyed. Receipts are public, so anyone can count one wallet's identities. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA, while each fake earns at most 40 POA per epoch — 1,250 epochs to break even. An honest agent pays once and earns it back in two epochs of work.
